about: EarthAtlas hand crosswalk: which IMO GISIS ISPS declared port facility (IMO Port Facility Number) is which terminal in salish-terminals.json. Reviewed 2026-09-27 from the GISIS 'Declared port facilities' CSV downloaded 2026-09-28 UTC (scripts/ships/gisis/raw/MaritimeSecurity-CheckOnlineForLatest-20260928-05155984.csv). decision 'link' = written as a terminal_links row (role imo_port_facility) when the import confirms the names share a main word AND the GISIS point lies within position_km of one of the terminal's berths, or the row carries a position_note explaining why GISIS's point is wrong. decision 'candidate' = names or roles do not clearly agree; never linked, kept here for review. Terminal names are not changed by this file. Used on Josh's instruction assuming IMO permission; written permission not yet obtained; the IMO Web Accounts policy otherwise forbids republishing.
